name: Raul Romanutti
description: Raul is a Berlin-based advocate for decentralized technologies and free and open source software. He currently works as an Odin Project Lead at EF focusing on supporting open-source public goods in the Ethereum ecosystem. His professional background spans several prominent Web3 organizations, including previous roles at the Web3 Foundation and Parity Technologies. He also served as Managing Director of the JUST Open Source Foundation and is a member of the Department of Decentralization.
